peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.6% below its local comparables; 21 of 34 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (21.6): 3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 8 of 44 similar developments (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Dhoby Ghaut MRT about 90 m, Bencoolen MRT about 470 m; closer than 37 of 44 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest ST. Margaret's School (Primary) about 390 m; more than 29 of 44 similar developments (the same as 12). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 110 m), more than 22 of 44 similar developments (the same as 10); nearest hawker centre Tekka Centre/Zhu Jiao Market about 820 m; nearest park Istana Park about 190 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 300 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 370 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 590 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 900 m; Canninghill Piers, 8 new sales, about 990 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 1,080 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 1,230 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,260 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 347 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,421 new sales and 1,113 resales (2,534 purchases); new sales were 56.1% of these purchases. Subsales (65) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 330 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,530 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,720 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,770 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,113 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 36 of 44 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,113 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,171 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−5%). Observed transactions, not a prediction.
